KEYPAD.gloss: a keyboard that is a data input device for computers
KEYPAD.definition: A keyboard that is a data input device for computers; arrangement of keys is modelled after the typewriter keyboard.

PEAKY.gloss: having or as if having especially high-pitched spots
PEAKY.definition: Having or as if having especially high-pitched spots.
PEAKY.example: Absence of peaky highs and beefed-up bass.

PEAK.gloss: the most extreme possible amount or value
PEAK.definition: The most extreme possible amount or value.

DYKE.gloss: offensive term for a lesbian who is noticeably masculine
DYKE.definition: (slang) offensive term for a lesbian who is noticeably masculine.

PAY.gloss: give money, usually in exchange for goods or services
PAY.definition: Give money, usually in exchange for goods or services.
PAY.example: I paid four dollars for this sandwich.

KEY.gloss: metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock…
KEY.definition: Metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated.

DAY.gloss: time for Earth to make a complete rotation on its axis
DAY.definition: Time for Earth to make a complete rotation on its axis.

PAD.gloss: a number of sheets of paper fastened together along one edge
PAD.definition: A number of sheets of paper fastened together along one edge.
